headline: Sensex Falls 429 Points as RBI Hikes Interest Rates; Rupee Hits Five-Month Low

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: The RBI hiked interest rates for the first time in nearly four years to combat persistent price pressures.
A hawkish pivot by the RBI caused the Indian Rupee to breach key support and hit a five-month low.
Significant selling in market heavyweights like Hindalco and Infosys dragged the benchmark indices lower.
Global sentiment was dampened by slipping US futures and a rebound in oil prices and bond yields.
whatHappening: The BSE Sensex settled 429 points lower at 22,603, while the Nifty 50 closed near the 22,600 level.
Lupin launched a new fixed-dose triple combo inhaler in India for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
Tata Motors' subsidiary Jaguar unveiled the Type 01, detailing its design, features, and pricing for the new model.
The GST Council is set to meet tomorrow to discuss potential reforms in tax processes and compliance.
summary: Indian indices closed lower on October 7, 2026, as a surprise RBI rate hike triggered a market sell-off. The Sensex dropped 429 points while the Rupee hit a five-month low due to the central bank's hawkish stance. Despite the decline, Lupin and Tata Motors saw positive news with new product and vehicle launches.
